symptom: Task UI loses non-empty assignment data, lacks composable priority filtering and live counts, and leaves a globally empty list without an actionable chat handoff.
root_cause: The task page derives and renders only the legacy task subset, uses one status-only filtered collection, and has no one-shot route contract to the existing chat submit boundary.
violated_invariant: Every task view must preserve non-empty task fields without fabricating absent values, derive filters and live statistics from the canonical task set, and expose an actionable global-empty recovery path.

fix_boundary.shared_layer: client task type plus TasksPage list derivation/render boundary and DailyBriefing chat submit entry
fix_boundary.rationale: One normalized frontend boundary covers every task record, status/priority combination, state transition and empty-list entry into chat.

cases.expected_invariant: Non-empty priority and assignment fields render on the owning task card.
